sc: The augmented pickaxe of earth and song is an augmented version of a pickaxe of earth and song, created by using an augmentor on an unaugmented pickaxe, or by creating the pickaxe of earth and song with an already augmented item.
It is made by using a Summoning pouch on a Summoning obelisk with 11 spirit shards, a gold charm, and a swamp toad in the backpack, requiring 66 Summoning and giving 87 experience.
It can be made into ten Barker Toad scrolls (Toad Bark) by using it on a summoning obelisk, giving 1 experience.
It can only be obtained and used while training Dungeoneering.
It can be created at level 18 Smithing from four bathus bars.

Bistromancer's urn.x: Bistromancer's urn is a back slot cosmetic override that is part of the Bistromancer's outfit.

sc: Black Giftwrapped Bow is a two-handed ranged weapon cosmetic override that is unlocked by redeeming a Black Giftwrapped Bow Token.
It is a possible reward from completing easy clue scrolls as part of the Treasure Trails Distraction and Diversion, or from cremating at the Columbarium.
Trimmed black armour cannot be made with the Smithing skill, nor can it be trimmed by any players.
They can be bought at the Sawmill Co.
Brutish 2h Sword was a two-handed melee weapon cosmetic override that could be unlocked by purchasing the Brutish Melee Weapon Pack.

The bubble maker is an item that can be bought from Diango to celebrate the wedding between the King Black Dragon and the Kalphite Queen (and the real life marriage between Kate Middleton and Prince William, which it parodies).
This item could also be obtained from Snow implings or from opening a Gift of Giving (active) during the 2012 Christmas event.
The mask was obtained by completing the crossover event's puzzle.
A carved oak magic wardrobe flatpack can be made at a workbench (Steel framed bench or better) in the workshop of a player-owned house.
The cavern key is an item obtained during the Creature of Fenkenstrain quest.
It is obtained by killing a level 35 wolf-woman Experiment in the Experiment cave.
Chaos runecrafting gloves are a reward that can be purchased with 150 tokens from the Fist of Guthix minigame.
A Christmas pudding is Christmas food that can be obtained from white and blue presents obtained from Christmas events since 2021.
Originally, it could be purchased from Diango in the Lumbridge Crater during the 2013 Christmas event for 50 coins.
Clawdia's shell clippings are a pet unlock item that may be received by participating in encounters against Clawdia.
Players obtain it by cleaning grimy volencia moss, found by searching rocks at the Karamjan central jungle mine north of Shilo Village (location) on Karamja.
They are first obtained in the quest Death Plateau, but cannot be equipped before completing it.
Players who finished the quest Death Plateau before the 31 January 2012 need to complete the quest again to obtain the boots from Freda.

Crusty Off-hand Baguette.x: The Crusty Off-hand Baguette is an off-hand melee weapon cosmetic override that can be unlocked by purchasing the Sandwich Lady Bundle.

sc: Crystal geodes are gem encrusted rocks that can be found while cutting crystal trees, or when cutting trees or ivy in Prifddinas when the Voice of Seren is active in the Crwys area.

Cylinder.x: Cylinders are items used in the enchantment room in the Mage Training Arena. They, like Icosahedrons, cubes, and Pentamids, can be turned into orbs used to obtain points in the minigame, they can be used to purchase rewards.

sc: The demonic title scroll (infernal) is a scroll dropped by the demon boss in a Demon Flash Mob.

Discarded sword blade.x: Discarded sword blade is an item used in the 2021 Halloween event. It can be found using Luna's compass around Draynor Manor. It is brought to Greg alongside the discarded sword hilt to create Arteria.

sc: The Dolorous Witch Outfit token (untradeable) is a reward from the 2024 Christmas event's Santa's Christmas Present.
Draccles is an off-hand magic weapon cosmetic override that is unlocked by completing The Lost Toys.
It is obtained alongside its item version.
Equipping the chaps will immediately cause them to begin degrading—even outside of combat—and they must be repaired before they can be traded again.
Elder rune arrowheads are items that can be made at level 90 Smithing, granting 505 Smithing experience and 75 arrowheads per elder rune bar, requiring 505 progress to complete.
They can be fletched into elder rune arrows at level 90 Fletching when used with headless shafts, which are made by using shafts with feathers, granting 280 experience per 15 arrows made.
It was obtained from the Squeal of Fortune, skilling, killing monsters, or by trading with other players.

sc: An erratic effigy (full) is a reward from the Effigy Incubator Distraction and Diversion.
Fallen leaves are an item that could be obtained from Treasure Hunter, training Farming and turning in daily challenges from 23 June to 27 June 2016.
From Farming they were obtained in batches of 15 once in an hour, and from daily challenges 25 could be obtained.

Feathered serpent skirt (red, female).x: The red feathered serpent skirt is part of the feathered serpent outfit item set. It gives no bonuses and is a cosmetic item.

sc: The Frosty Cerberus boots token is a reward from the Cerberus Frost Treasure Hunter promotion.
It can be redeemed to unlock the Frosty Cerberus boots cosmetic override, destroying the token after a confirmation prompt.
The furnished gorajan trailblazer head is part of the furnished gorajan trailblazer outfit that is available from Treasure Hunter.
It can also be created from 3,600 dungeoneering fragments with level 80 Dungeoneering and 20 Invention.
It is received as a drop from onyx dragons, or can be purchased on the Grand Exchange or from other players.

Gemstone Wings (Magic).x: Gemstone Wings (Magic) is a wings slot cosmetic override that can be unlocked by purchasing the Gemstone Wings. It matches the magic golem outfit, though unlike the outfit the wings are purely cosmetic and offer no benefits.

sc: The ghostly farmer trousers are part of the ghostly farmer outfit which is made with 600 ghostweave.
Gift wrap scythe is a melee weapon that was first made obtainable from the Santa's Grotto Treasure Hunter promotion from 25 December 2021 to 31 December 2021.
The golden Akrisae's robe skirt is armour that can be won from the Balthazar's Big Raffle from 2017 onward.
Green logs are created by using a green firelighter (obtainable from completing any clue scroll) on some normal logs.

Hellion Cape.x: The Hellion Cape is a back slot cosmetic override that can be purchased, along with the rest of the Hellion outfit, for 1 premier reward token from the Premier Token Store. It could originally be unlocked upon purchasing the 2018 Premier Club package or the 2018 Summer Special.

sc: The Helm of Keening is the result of killing 200 banshees with the Mask of Mourning, which is available from the Shattered Worlds Reward Shop for 1.
The Herblore master cape is the cape awarded for achieving true skill mastery by reaching level 120 (requiring a total of 104,273,167 experience) Herblore.
The cape is sold by Kaqemeex in Taverley and by Elen Anterth in the Max Guild for 120,000 coins.
The hooded max cape is obtained by combining a max cape with a max hood.
It does not appear in the worn equipment interface, and cannot be obtained as an actual item.
A star was also a reward for completing the Yak to Basics task set.
It can be won on Treasure Hunter during the Cerberus Rush promotion.
It, along with the regular smithing skillcape, could be unlocked by accounts in the Fresh Start Worlds game mode that reached level 99 Smithing.

The cape can also still be unlocked by any account in the main game by consuming an Inverted Smithing skillcape token, though the inverted cape can only be equipped if the player also has level 99 Smithing.

The drop rate for this book is higher in story mode with a base rate estimated at 1/10 using the following formula:
• (10+X)/100 where X is the amount of group and solo kills
This would guarantee the player will receive the book as a drop if running the dungeon in story mode with 90 kills or more recorded outside of story mode.
This rate can be further increased by 10% by wearing a Dungeoneering master cape. It is currently unknown if a perfect juju dungeoneering potion contributes in a similar way, despite having similar effects to the cape's perk. 
Despite being a lore drop, odds of receiving the book are unaffected by the Lorehound pet's Lore Helper perk.

sc: Shadow Linza is a cosmetic override outfit that can be purchased for 1,500 H'oddments from the H'oddments Store.

Spiked & poisoned egg.x: A spiked & poisoned egg is used in the final wave of Barbarian Assault. It is made by using spikes on a poisoned egg. It must be passed on to the defender to make an omega egg.

sc: The spinebeam shortbow is an item that can only be obtained and used while training Dungeoneering.
It may be picked up from the table at the beginning of a dungeon, obtained as a monster drop, or produced using the Fletching skill.
It was made by combining a crimson charm with 1 spirit shards and a Dagannoth hide.

Spirit gems, which are dropped by all monsters that drop a single charm and could be received from the Squeal of Fortune, functioned similarly to Runecrafting pouches and stored uncharged summoning pouches before an update.
One charge is consumed for each pouch that is created through the gem.
The strange artefact is the helmet created through the completion of the second and third God Emissary jobs.

tx:
Attempting to pickpocket an NPC that a player has the Thieving level for (even if unsuccessful); stealing from stalls; stealing from chests. 
Master Farmers are recommended for lower-level thieves because of their left-click pickpocket option. For higher-level thieves, thieving elven clan workers are a good, relaxed option due to the lack of attention needed. Knocking out and pickpocketing Menaphite Thugs also works.
The Pyramid Plunder minigame can give strange rocks whilst pick-locking doors between rooms or searching the urns, but not from the chests or sarcophagi. But the sarcophagi in Shifting Tombs can drop the rock.
Safecracking is the best choice, as safes provide experience drops at quick tick intervals, allowing for the highest chance of acquiring strange rocks.
